Install Elise and start a panel node with one command:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phungvanquy/elise/refs/tags/v1.0.5/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- install v1.0.5 --panel-url='https://panel.example.com' --api-key='REPLACE_WITH_PANEL_KEY' --node-id=123 --node-type=vless
```

- New non-interactive node options work with both the installer and `elisectl add`. The existing interactive wizard remains available.
- Specify `--node-type` to match the panel node. XBoard and listen address `0.0.0.0` are the defaults; override them with `--panel-type` and `--listen`.
- For certificate TLS, supply `--cert-mode=file` with certificate/key paths, `--cert-mode=http` with domain/email, or `--cert-mode=self-signed` with a domain. The example above assumes VLESS REALITY or no TLS. REALITY keys come from the panel.
- Use `--api-key-file` instead of a literal key to keep credentials out of command history and process arguments. Panel error diagnostics redact the API key.
- Preflight checks run before replacing Elise files or restarting existing services. Existing instances are never overwritten. A failed first start keeps configuration/certificates for diagnosis and returns an error.
- Linux amd64 and arm64 release archives contain matching installer and management tools with SHA-256 checksums.

This release changes installation tools and the version identifier; it retains the v1.0.4 protocol implementation. Updating a running installation briefly disconnects its active nodes.

See the [installation examples and TLS options](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise#install-and-start-a-node-in-one-command).
